name: Marios Pittas
intro: I'm Marios Pittas, a frontend developer and UI/UX designer based in Vratsa, Bulgaria. Over the past ten years I've turned a lifelong interest in computers into a career bridging design and code — designing clean, intuitive interfaces in Figma and bringing them to life with React, TypeScript, Webflow or WordPress.
aboutSub: Hello! My name is Marios Pittas. I am 31 years old, based in Vratsa, Bulgaria, and a proud dad to a six-month-old.
aboutParagraphs: Over the past ten years, I have turned my lifelong interest in computers into a career in front-end development and UI/UX design. My real strength is bridging the gap between design and code. I enjoy designing clean, intuitive interfaces in Figma and bringing them to life with React, TypeScript, Webflow or WordPress.

I like taking full ownership of projects from the first idea to the final launch. Lately, I have been focused on building interactive web apps from scratch, turning complex requirements into clean and reusable code. I put a lot of effort into making sure my projects are fully mobile responsive, fast, and accessible.

I am fluent in English, highly comfortable with modern tech stacks, and always learning new tools to improve my work. I believe the best results happen when great design meets solid engineering, and I am excited to bring that mix of creativity and clean code to a great team.
education: Bachelor's degree in Web Design & Image Advertising — Sofia, September 2019 – Present
